text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Thank you so much for the training today!"
choice_data_list: Good work today. Don't forget to ice down, alright?
Good work today. Don't forget to ice yourself down, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(A little over two months have passed
since we began the "Training Arc.")

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We set a new record handing out flyers today!
We handed out 520 copies in just two hours!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(The level of our special training is going up day by day.
In some subjects, we've practically maxed it out.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh? We're not doing the ball-juggling special training anymore?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Which means—
I've developed the strength this menu was meant to train!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's switch to a different menu next time.
Yeah, let's try a different menu next time.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo!
I'll be waiting for our next special training session!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(After this training arc,
my abilities have steadily improved!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *phew*—
Trainer, what was my time for the 200m sprint...!
choice_data_list: No, not quite at the target time yet...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Why don't we try using 'Power Ankles' on the treadmill today!?
choice_data_list: Hmm... could you hold on a moment?
Hmm... could you wait on that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ankle weights are designed to increase exercise intensity.
If you wear them carelessly while running outside of strength training, your form will break down, leading to injuries.
choice_data_list: I'll take it off when it's not needed. It's for your own good.
I'll take it off when it's not necessary. It's for your sake.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“......Okaaay.
Understooood.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew... haah...—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What am I supposed to doooo?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's already been two months! Two whole months, you know?!
So whyyy isn't my time improving?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm not allowed to leave the ankle weights on all the time, either!
And the special training is surprisingly plain stuff!
If this were a manga—

text_block_list.name: Protagonist's Master
text_block_list.text:
Now, remove those wrist weights and throw a punch.
Do that, and thou shalt...

text_block_list.name: Manga Protagonist
text_block_list.text:
—!? I-I can't believe it...!
Did my fist just shatter a giant boulder...!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …………――I can do it too.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If I were in the world of manga,
I'd deliver results in 19 pages flat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To train those explosive accelerator muscles,
we were doing stair dashes at a nearby shrine today.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Kiseki! Kiseki-!
I'll come watch your next race too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wah. Th-Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since her debut race,
Kiseki's fanbase has been growing.
Her running style truly is captivating.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Um... how about trying to enter more races!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Skill takes time to build up bit by bit, I know!
But it's about time I—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――... Me too.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I know I'm not gonna
improve overnight, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The growing impatience surrounding her is palpable.
No matter how much training she puts in,
she feels the goal is still so far away... along with that bitter frustration.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, if it's no good, then at least push me
all the way until I can't even stand up anymore,
would you!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "All those needless thoughts, thoughts that aren't fitting for a protagonist... I just wanted to fill my head with nothing but training."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, Kiseki is still in the Junior Class. We can't have her breaking down from an unreasonable training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I wanted to find a breakthrough
for her sake as she grew increasingly exhausted.
And what I prepared was—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
About today's special training...

"You're with me!
Let's give it our all!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaah, Kita-chaaaan!
Kita-chan, you can do it~~!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Kitasan Black-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black.
Always the first to lend a hand to anyone in trouble, the unrivaled big-hearted helper.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: 1st place in the Tenno Sho (Spring) and 3rd in the Takarazuka Kinen this year. With both immense popularity and true strength—she really is the face of this era.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, why!?
Aren't you supposed to be busy preparing for autumn...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry about that!
If anything, having more comrades makes me feel all the more reassured!
choice_data_list: From now on, you'll be doing the same routine as her.
From now on, you'll be doing the same routine as her.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Kh, me doing the exact same training
as the hero of an era... heh...!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! By the way, what I'll be doing
is just my usual training routine, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Are you still okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Of course!!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hup, hup, fuu, fuu—
Wasshoi! Wasshoi!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, heh, heheh...!
Wasshoi! Wasshoi!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (I... I know it!!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan does three slope runs—
that notoriously punishing training regimen!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I bet her other workouts are just as brutal,
harsh, and utterly insane like something
straight out of a battle manga!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew, good work, Kiseki-san!
Was that too tough?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Not at all!
I can totally keep up, bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
I'll go for one more lap, then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I breathe a sigh of relief.
Training with Kitasan Black seems like it'll be a great change of pace for Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“And I hope they learn 'what it takes' to become strong
from Kitasan Black.
With that wish in mind, I watch over them.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... Kita-chan!
That was a great warm-up! Next is the hill climb...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...? The slope?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Hm?
...You're not gonna do it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, physical conditioning is my top priority this autumn!
I want to give 120% when it counts for real, after all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I was thinking of taking it nice and slow at this pace today, finishing up after half a lap!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Ah... I-I see!
So, sort of taking it slow like that...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Did you just think 'maybe I should have pushed myself harder~' or something?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Still, a steady effort over three days can easily beat pushing yourself for one day and resting for two!
Consistency without rushing is what really matters when making an effort!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(At that moment, I felt like my eyes met
with Trainer watching over me from the stands.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Even if you tell me that,
I already know it perfectly well, alright?!!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer looks so pleased with themselves, too!
So satisfied!
I already understood well enough from the start!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Steady, honest effort is what matters most!
Muscles don't grow overnight!
—Reality isn't like manga!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I know that! But—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Kita-chan doesn't complain either.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Keep quietly putting in the hard work, step by step.
With a bright smile that makes breaking a sweat look effortless, never showing a hint of frustration—)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Just like a manga protagonist.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...What's the matter, Kiseki-san?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah—!
No, um...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Right now, Kita-chan is giving me
her precious time. And besides...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Trainer gave me this opportunity because they were thinking of me, after all.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Pheeew, never mind!
I decided I was gonna stick with you today, after all!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(I understand it logically, but I can't accept it...
......It's just a matter of my own feelings, isn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Because Kita-chan stays focused on what's in front of her
and on the steady, groundwork stuff.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (...Don't let your mind wander.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"First, keep at it, doing the exact same thing.
...Give it a try, copy me."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(If I keep at it like Kita-chan,
...even this haze will clear right up.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (......Probably.)
